notes: First financial authenticator enrollment needs a fresh email code (2026-10-31, security audit 2026-10-29 finding 8, Medium; owner 2026-10-31 "First-time financial authenticator enrollment: whether it should require a fresh email code. - yes"). Login is email OTP, so whoever held the session of a member who never enrolled could enroll their own authenticator through /auth/mfa/associate and pass every financial step-up. The accepted auth-financial-totp.mjs bytes issue no secret to a user without a verified enrollment (never enrolled, a pending setup, or reset by a teammate through SQL 133) until a 6-digit code emailed to the user's verified address (identity mapping, else the id token; never the request body) is entered: associate without a code emails one (rate action enroll_start) and answers 428 email_code_required with a signed challenge; associate with the challenge and code checks it (rate action enroll_confirm, 5 per 300 s per user, committed before the compare; 401 email_code_invalid, 410 email_code_expired after 10 minutes, 409 email_code_used once the pending row it was sent for is replaced) and issues the secret and a signed enrollment ticket bound to the new pending row; verify of a pending row needs that ticket (403 enrollment_email_code_required otherwise, including rows set up before this change). On the first activation the user is emailed that an authenticator was added (the activation is committed first; a failed email never undoes it). Verified enrollments' verify and step-up are unchanged. No code is stored in a table: the challenge carries an HMAC of the code (key derived from the financial TOTP wrap key with HKDF), the user, the email digest, the expiry and the row state. In production the code email must be delivered by SES or the answer is 503 email_code_send_failed; a non-production sink returns stagingDebugCode as homeowner-otp.mjs does. No SQL: enroll_start and enroll_confirm are accepted actions of the live consume_financial_totp_rate_limit (SQL 130). New static imports: email.mjs and email-layout.mjs (not overlay members; the live package carries them, and the live checkalt-register.mjs imports the same exports), email-branding.mjs platformBranding (imported by the live checkalt-register.mjs) and email-policy.mjs (live at its accepted bytes). auth-financial-totp.mjs live_sha256 3edfea2a is the bytes the SQL 132 lockout production apply (run 41190246725) recorded (previous_manifest). sql_before stays SQL 132. The SPA change (src/lib/awsMfa.ts, StepUpDialog.tsx, TotpManagerCard.tsx) asks for the emailed code and works against both these bytes and the live ones, so it ships first or together with the next guarded website deploy. A read-only production overlay inspect must confirm the live member before any apply.
